Palladium-Catalyzed T riple Cyclization of 2,7-Alkadiynylic
Carbonates with 2-Butyne-1,4-diol or
2-Butyne-1,4-disulfonamides
Y ulong Song,
a
W angteng W u,
a
Chunling Fu,
a
Xin Huang,
a

a,

Laboratory of Molecular Recognition and Synthesis, Department of Chemistry , Zhejiang University , Hangzhou 310027,
Zhejiang, People’ s Republic of China
Fax: (+ 86)21-6416-7510
E-mail: masm@sioc.ac.cn

Supporting information for this article is available on the WWW under https://doi.or g/10.1002/adsc.201900162
Abstract: A palladium-catalyzed highly E-selective
triple cyclization of 2,7-alkadiynylic carbonates
with 2-butyne-1,4-diol or 2-butyne-1,4-disulfon-
amides to construct diff erent tricycles such as 6,8-
dihydrobenzo[1,2-c:3,4-c’]difuran-1(3H)-one and
1,3,6,7-tetrahydro-8H-furo[3,4-e]isoindol-8-one de-
rivatives has been reported. The alkene group
produced and the nucleophilic unit kept in the
product provide further opportunity to construct
more complicated polycycles. The control experi-
ments showed that the reaction mainly go through
an intermolecular insertion of the alkynes before the
lactonization or lactamization.
Keywords: palladium; benzopolycycle; 2,7-alkadiy-
nylic carbonates; 2-butyne-1,4-diol; 2-butyne-1,4-di-
sulfonamide
Polycycles containing heterocycles such as lactones
and lactams are of great importance due to their
potential biological activities.
[1]
Thus, they have drawn
much attention of the chemists to develop more
eff icient synthetic methods.
[2–8]
Common approaches to
construct these types of skeletons include: (1) intra-
molecular [2 + 2 + 2] cycloaddition of 1,6,1 1-
triynes;
[3,4]
(2) the Hexadehydro-Diels-Alder (HDDA)
reaction of 1,3,8-triynes followed by the addition with
intramolecular or intermolecular electrophiles;
[5,6]
(3)
intra- or intermolecular domino reactions consisting of
oxidative addition, carbopalladation, Heck couplings
and consecutive 6π-electrocyclizations of alkenyl hal-
ides with one or more alkyne moieties;
[7]
(4) intermo-
lecular tandem reactions consisting of oxidative
addition, Sonogashira couplings and sequenced Gar-
ratt-Braverman cyclization of alkenyl iodides with 1,6-
diynes.
[8]
Nowadays, palladium-catalyzed cyclization
of propar gyl alcohol derivatives with unsaturated
hydrocarbons such as alkenes, alkynes, and allenes has
been a powerful tool to prepare polycycles.
[9]
Recently ,
our group developed an eff icient benzofuran construc-
tion via a Pd-catalyzed intermolecular annulation of
2,7-alkadiynylic carbonates with functionalized termi-
nal alkynes (Scheme 1a).
[10]
W e assumed that if the R
group at 8-position is replaced with an ester group, the
newly designed 2,7-alkadiynylic carbonates may react
with symmetric internal alkynes such as 2-butyne-1,4-
diol or 2-butyne-1,4-disulfonamides to form tricyclic
compounds with an extra lactone or lactam unit
(Scheme 1b).
W ith this notion in mind, we initially conducted the
reaction of 2,7-alkadiynylic carbonate (4 a) with 2-

6 da in 69% yield with an E/Z ratio of 95/5. After
recrystallization, 65% yield of (E)-6 da was obtained
with an improved E/Z ratio of 98/2. Secondary 2,7-
alkadiynylic carbonates were also applicable and trans-
ferred into the tricyclic lactones (E)-6 ea ~ (E)-6 ga in
63 ~ 71% yields with excellent E/Z ratios. In addition, a
propyl group could be introduced into 4-position of the
starting material (6 ha). Such a strategy was also
compatible for the construction of nitrogen- or carbon-
tethered tricyclic lactones (6 ia–6 ja). It’ s worth men-
tioning that the preparation of 6 aa could be easily
scaled up to a 4-mmol scale.
However , when we extended the carbon chain on
each side by one carbon atom, i. e., hex-3-yn-1,6-diol
(eq. a in Scheme 2) or used hex-3-yn-2,5-diol (eq. b in
Scheme 2), the reaction was complicated and the
expected product was formed.
Furthermore, it was exciting to find that 2-butyne-
1,4-diol could be replaced with 2-butyne-1,4-disulfon-
amides. The corresponding tricyclic lactams were
delivered in moderate yields of 37 ~ 58% (T able 3).
When 2-butyne-1,4-diol was replaced with 2-butyne-
1,4-disulfonamides, the products were impure after
chromatography on silica gel, which should be further
purified by recrystallization (DCM/hexane) to aff ord

proc ess, the lactonization of 4 a and 5 a aff orded a
triyne intermediate IN-5 first. Subsequent intramolecu-
lar carbopalladations would aff ord the final product.
W e reasoned that CuI may play a role in the intra-
molecular insertion of IN-1 forming IN-2.
In order to unveil the mechanism of this reaction,
some control experiments have been carried out
(Scheme 4). The reaction of 4 a with terminal prop-
arg yl alcohol 5 d afforded a tricyclic lactone product
7 ad in 8% yield, together with a benzofuran product
8 ad in 49% yield. Obviously , the product 7 ad was
formed after the lactonization of the regioselective
isomer of 8 ad. The reaction of 4 b with 5 d gave
similar results. Both of the two reactions indicated that
the intermolecular process should be the major
mechanistic route, otherwise the tricyclic product 7
should be the main product. The reaction in the
absence of CuI was complicated-the formation of the
product was not detected after one hour under standard
conditions (eq. c in Scheme 4), indicating the impor -
tance of CuI for this transformation. In addition, under
the optimized conditions, when the reaction time was
shortened from 3.5 h to one hour , bicyclic intermediate
product 9 ad was indeed isolated (eq. d in Scheme 4).
Moreover , when 7 ad was submitted to the standard
conditions, the formation of 9 ad was not observed and
100% of 7 ad was recovered (eq. e in Scheme 4),
ruling out the possibility of hydrolysis of lactone 7 ad
forming 9 ad. These results further support the inter -
molecular proc ess shown in Scheme 3.
Some synthetic applications have been performed
to show the potential of the products (Scheme 5). The
Fe(NO
3

· 9H
2
O catalyzed aerobic oxidation of 6 ab
proceeded smoothly to give the aryl aldehyde 10 aa in
76% yield.
[13]
The tetra-cyclic lactone 1 1 aa was easily
obtained through an electrophilic cyclization with NBS
(1.5 equiv .).
[14]
In summary , we have developed an efficient and
stereoselective method for the construction of tricyclic
lactones or lactams via a palladium-catalyzed 8-
methyoxycarbonyl substituted 2,7-alkadiynylic carbo-
nates with 2-butyne-1,4-diol or 2-butyne-1,4-disulfon-
amides. After the studies of control experiments, we
reasoned that the reaction should preferentially go
through intermolecular carbopalladations before the
